name: Turkcell Izmir Data Center (Menderes)
notes: Turkcell Izmir Data Center inaugurated 22 June 2017; first Tier III-certified DC in the Aegean region, ~17,600 sqm indoor area, LEED Gold candidate; part of Turkcell's 8-DC network. No public site MW.

name: Vodafone-Edgnex (DAMAC) Izmir Data Center
developer: Edgnex Data Centres by DAMAC / Vodafone Turkey (50-50 JV)
notes: USD 100m 50/50 JV (Feb 2024) for a Tier III data center in Izmir with initial 6 MW IT load expandable to 12 MW; Invest.gov.tr official coverage; Serban (EPC contractor) page confirms Tier III Izmir project. Q1 2025 opening target may have slipped; status construction.

name: Vodafone Turkey Izmir Data Center (existing)
notes: Vodafone Turkey already operated a data center in Izmir (Baxtel notes the Edgnex JV facility is Vodafone's second in Izmir / sixth in Turkey). Capacity not published.

name: Netdirekt Izmir Data Center
notes: Netdirekt operates an Izmir data center with multi-ISP connectivity per official page; regional colo/hosting operator. Capacity not published.

name: PlusLayer Izmir Data Center
notes: Official PlusLayer page: three data center halls totaling 350 m2 (200+110+40 m2) in Konak, Izmir; among Turkey's top-5 hosting data centers by IP space (2022); operates 200k+ hosted websites.

name: Kayseri OSB Veri Merkezi
notes: Official Kayseri OSB announcement (30 Oct 2025): Data Center project started - IT directorate began infrastructure and software work after the September 2025 general assembly; will host industrial users' data locally (rental/hybrid model), target service by end-2026. Capacity not yet defined.

name: Kayseri operating data center (unnamed operator)
notes: June 2026 Sabah column lists Kayseri among provinces with one operating data center; operator/capacity unnamed. Weak lead.

name: Turkcell Gebze Data Center
notes: Opened 2016 in Gebze as Turkey's largest data center; ~35,000 m2, Tier III certified, LEED Gold; 4th module delivered 2021 (~12.6 MW per contractor Serban). Site MW total not officially published; do not allocate Turkcell group totals to this site.

name: ENKA Data Solutions EDS IST-02 Gebze Data Center
notes: Carrier-neutral colocation in Gebze (Beylikbagi): 18 MW IT load on 30 MW total power, 1,800+ cabinets, 15 kW/cabinet, Uptime Tier III + TS EN 50600, N+2, seismic isolation per official page.

name: TUBITAK BILGEM Gebze campus data center infrastructure
notes: National research institute campus in Gebze hosting government-grade data-center and certificate-authority infrastructure (institutional/public). No capacity figure.

name: Kocaeli Korfez regional data center (Isimkayit)
notes: Regional ISP claims the first and only data center in Kocaeli Korfez district, built from 2019 (company/operator page evidence); small-scale hosting facility, capacity not published.

name: TURKSAT Konya Data Center project
notes: TURKSAT announced (2017-2019) a ~50,000 m2 government data center in Konya for public data storage; no evidence of completion - TURKSAT's flagship new DC was anchored at Golbasi, Ankara (groundbreaking 2025). Status uncertain.

name: KOP data-center-region feasibility initiative (Veri Merkezleri Bolgesi Uygunluk Arastirmasi)
developer: KOP Bolge Kalkinma Idaresi (Ministry of Industry and Technology)
notes: Feasibility/positioning study (2015-2019) to make the KOP region (Konya) a 'Veri Merkezleri Bolgesi' / informatics valley; promoted internationally (Frankfurt). No concrete facility built as of publication.

name: Konya operating data center (unnamed operator)
notes: June 2026 Sabah column lists Konya among provinces with one operating data center; operator/capacity unnamed. Weak lead.

name: MUSKI Data Center
developer: MUSKI (Mugla Water and Sewerage Administration / Mugla Metropolitan Municipality)
notes: Mugla utility's newly commissioned data center equipped with redundant power sources and advanced security to strengthen municipal services (local press); no MW figure.

name: Allturko Yer Alti Veri Merkezi (underground data center)
developer: Allturko (Konya-based technology company; chairman Kivanc Kalin)
notes: Anadolu Agency/memurlar reports: ~1 billion TL (~USD 20m) underground data center in Nevsehir/Cappadocia, 27 m below ground, 3 floors/corridors; phase 1 = 2 MW, 20 rooms, ~200 cabinets (mostly pre-sold); phase 2 target 5 MW; supported by Ministry of Industry and Technology and Ahiler Development Agency; construction expected during 2026, service in ~28 months.

name: Kapadokya (Cappadocia) rock-cut storage conversion to data centers
notes: Initiative to convert Nevsehir/Cappadocia natural rock-cut storage caverns into energy-efficient data centers (natural insulation cuts cooling costs); no concrete investor or completed facility confirmed.
